question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Jane Eyre, Claire gets Persuasion, Dave gets Dracula, Eve gets Middlemarch, Fred gets Dune, and Gertrude gets Emma.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Dave swap books. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap books. Then, Dave and Claire swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap books. Then, Eve and Alice swap books. Finally, Dave and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Gertrude has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Persuasion
(D) Dracula
(E) Middlemarch
(F) Dune
(G) Emma
solution:
Each row lists books in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: Walden, Jane Eyre, Persuasion, Dracula, Middlemarch, Dune, Emma
1. Bob ↔ Dave: Walden, Dracula, Persuasion, Jane Eyre, Middlemarch, Dune, Emma
2. Gertrude ↔ Claire: Walden, Dracula, Emma, Jane Eyre, Middlemarch, Dune, Persuasion
3. Dave ↔ Claire: Walden, Dracula, Jane Eyre, Emma, Middlemarch, Dune, Persuasion
4. Claire ↔ Eve: Walden, Dracula, Middlemarch, Emma, Jane Eyre, Dune, Persuasion
5. Claire ↔ Gertrude: Walden, Dracula, Persuasion, Emma, Jane Eyre, Dune, Middlemarch
6. Eve ↔ Alice: Jane Eyre, Dracula, Persuasion, Emma, Walden, Dune, Middlemarch
7. Dave ↔ Alice: Emma, Dracula, Persuasion, Jane Eyre, Walden, Dune, Middlemarch
Gertrude has Middlemarch, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
